tier: single confirmatory tilt + hierarchical max-statistic-null descriptive cross
rationale: Macro x sector timing is DOA on power + data-mining grounds (Welch-Goyal; Molchanov-Stangl 'Myth of Business Cycle Sector Rotation'; youBet failed regime conditioning twice). A naive 5x11x3 = 165-hypothesis cross is Holm death. The pre-registered confirmatory footprint is therefore a SINGLE theory-anchored binary tilt; the full grid is descriptive with a max-statistic permutation null.

core_strategies.name: vrp_defensive_tilt
core_strategies.hypothesis: Overweight defensive sectors (XLP/XLU/XLV constituents) vs cyclicals (XLK/XLY/XLI/XLB/XLE) when the variance risk premium (VIX - trailing realized vol) is elevated.
core_strategies.confirmatory_input_restriction: market-derived not-revised ONLY: {vix, realized_vol}. AAII/VVIX/MOVE/CNN-F&G and any revised/reconstructed series are FORBIDDEN in this gate.
core_strategies.bucketing: SPDR-proxy / coarse defensive-vs-cyclical partition INVARIANT across 2016 Real-Estate spinout and 2018 Comm-Services reclassification. Per-stock sector_as_of names with missing/'nan' sector are EXCLUDED (never bucketed). Real Estate / Comm Services / Telecom deliberately unclassified.
core_strategies.threshold: pre-committed quantile of VRP (top tercile) — FROZEN before run
core_strategies.expected_band_anchor: Bollerslev-Tauchen-Zhou VRP is aggregate, short-horizon (OOS R^2 ~4%), halved for decay.

descriptive_cross.discipline: PRE-REGISTERED in full; report the WHOLE-grid excess-Sharpe distribution overlaid with a random-permutation null band. NO single cell is a 'finding' unless it survives a max-statistic (Romano-Wolf / White reality-check) permutation test across all 165 cells. This is the honest descriptive analogue of Holm.
descriptive_cross.effective_sample_note: Macro panel mixing VVIX(2007+)/putcall(2006-11+)/DTWEXBGS(2006+) starts ~2007, not 2005 -> recompute MDE on the shorter sample.
descriptive_cross.hierarchical: Runs as a GATE only if vrp_defensive_tilt passes (it is not expected to). Otherwise descriptive-with-null only.

multiplicity: vrp_defensive_tilt is the 2nd member of the joint N=2 gate family (distinct hypothesis from the value signal). Romano-Wolf simultaneous CI headline.
